text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a spike in inbound leads stuck in the enrichment queue this morning. HS enrichment webhook to Clearbit returns 502 intermittently, and our RR assigner waits for enrichment before claiming. ~150 leads in limbo.
alex: ugh. any errors in the logs? link?
maria: safe to share truncated log: `enqueue: lead_id=98765 status=pending enrichment_attempts=3 last_error=502`
alex: thanks. looks like the webhook times out after 10s and we then pause assignment. we should probably not block RR on enrichment.
jess: agreed. proposal: add a 30s grace window — if enrichment hasn't returned, fallback to minimal assign (email + phone only) and mark for post-enrich update. also add a dead-letter queue for leads that fail enrichment 5x. :white_check_mark:
sam: +1. can we implement a heartbeat for the HS->enrichment connector so we can alert before backlog grows? small lambda that pings endpoint and records 200/5xx to metrics.
paul: for SF mapping, if enrichment is missing, map owner based on territory rules in HS properties. avoid creating unowned leads in SF.
maria: workflow changes I'll propose in HubSpot: (1) change assignment workflow so it doesn't await enrichment record, (2) flag leads with enrichment_pending=true, (3) push to DLQ after 5 failures. drafting now.
alex: for quick mitigation, can we toggle config to allow assign_on_no_enrich=true? ops, is that safe?
ops-bot: deploybot: flag update request received. patch branch: `hotfix/assign-on-no-enrich` ready for canary. CI green.
jess: runbook note: when DLQ > 50 in 10m, page #marketing-ops and create incident. Also add a janitor job to retry DLQ every 1h with exponential backoff.
sam: sample heartbeat snippet I used elsewhere:```bash
curl -sSf https://enrich.internal/health || echo "enrich down" | send-alert
```
paul: SF owner fallback mapping pseudo:```sql
UPDATE leads l
SET owner_id = t.owner_id
FROM territories t
WHERE l.country = t.country AND l.owner_id IS NULL;
```
maria: timeline: quick toggle (assign_on_no_enrich) — today EOD; DLQ + janitor + heartbeat — by EOD tomorrow; HS workflow change + SF mapping — by end of week. owners: alex (toggle + monitor), jess (DLQ/runbook), sam (heartbeat), paul (SF mapping), maria (HS workflow + comms).
alex: I'll watch metrics and post a summary at 10:30am.
jess: can we also add a small observability card on console for enrichment latency percentile? 95th p95 alert.
maria: yes added to roadmap ticket. pinging folks for reviews. :pray:
paul: one more ask — include a user-facing note for sales: how to tell if a lead is missing enrichment and what to do. draft in #sales later.
maria: good call, will DM draft. thanks team.
ops-bot: incidentbot: created incident INC-2026-031 for enrichment-backend degraded. updates will be posted here.
